messages:
maria_privsec: FYI discovered failed DSAR erasure for request req-0c12 after yesterday's KMS rotation. Delete worker threw AccessDenied when decrypting archived snapshot. Seems like an RBAC cleanup removed the job SA from key policy.
ashwin_eng: Paste the worker log snippet?
maria_privsec: ```
2026-03-20T11:02:03Z dsar-erasure ERROR KMSDecryptError: AccessDenied: projects/.../cryptoKeys/redwood-dsar: caller does not have permission
job=req-0c12 snapshot=snap-b2a
```
samir_ops: Oncall  which SA runs the erase?
maria_privsec: `sa-dsar-writer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
samir_ops: Checking key IAM policy now. We ran an RBAC tidy-up Friday that removed non-exempt SAs; likely the culprit.
jlee_legal: User asked for status. If we miss the statutory erase SLA we must document a retention exception and notify. Legal can approve emergency temporary access but need full evidence chain.
nashwin_eng: Triage plan: confirm alias->key version, dump key policy (`gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy`), and pull KMS audit entries for recent Decrypts.
maria_privsec: Alias points to version 2 (rotated). Key policy has no dsar SA, only infra viewer roles. Snapshot metadata shows `archival_hold=true` at time of request.
samir_ops: Short-term mitigation: grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `sa-dsar-writer` on that cryptoKey for 30 minutes, run erasure, collect KMS audit + job output, then revoke. Requesting legal signoff.
jlee_legal: Approved for one-time limited grant solely to complete req-0c12 erasure. Approval note: "Emergency KMS decrypt for DSAR req-0c12 due to policy drift after rotation; actions logged and auditable." Include ids in logs.
maria_privsec: I'll record audit metadata: dsar_id=req-0c12, snapshot_ids=[snap-b2a], performed_by=samir_ops, approval=jlee_legal, retention_exception=false.
samir_ops: Applying binding with approval note and recording change in infra-change log.
security-bot: Incident INC-4920 created by maria_privsec. Severity: P2. https://incidents.redwood/4920
samir_ops: Re-running erasure job...
samir_ops: Erasure job succeeded: "complete: snapshots purged for req-0c12". KMS audit recorded Decrypt by `sa-dsar-writer` at 2026-03-20T11:09:47Z. Revoking temporary binding now.
jlee_legal: Please upload: (1) IAM change record, (2) KMS audit entry, (3) erasure job log, (4) requester confirmation. Legal will verify and close.
maria_privsec: Postmortem actions: 1) add DSAR SAs to KMS onboarding checklist (owner: ashwin_eng). 2) add an e2e DSAR test that includes KMS rotation scenario (owner: ashwin_eng). 3) design automated rewrap for long-lived snapshots to avoid manual grants (owner: samir_ops). 4) create alert for key IAM drift when DSAR SAs are missing (owner: samir_ops).
ashwin_eng: I'll open the tickets and attach runbook template for emergency grants.
samir_ops: I'll draft rewrap design and monitoring rule.
maria_privsec: Notifying support and product for comms. Attaching evidence to INC-4920 and will close after legal signoff.
security-bot: Incident INC-4920 status updated: Mitigated by samir_ops. Evidence bundle: https://incidents.redwood/4920/evidence
